title: security(core): WidgetRegistry loads a widget from source.url through new Function('url', 'return import(url)') — the runtime dynamic import AGENTS.md #6 forbids; retire the module source
body:
## 维护者速读

`packages/core/src/registry/WidgetRegistry.ts` 的 `case 'module'` 分支用 `new Function('url', 'return import(url)')` 按清单里的 URL 远程加载组件代码。AGENTS.md 诫条 #6 原文：「No `eval()` / runtime dynamic imports to load components (security)」。该路径不是死代码：`cli` 的脚手架与 `create-plugin` 模板仍生成 `type: 'module'` 清单。建议删掉 `module` 来源，只保留 `inline` / `registry`。

## Measured (2026-10-24, HEAD 7981384)

- The sink: in `WidgetRegistry.ts`, the `case 'module':` arm builds `const dynamicImport = new Function('url', 'return import(url)')` and awaits `dynamicImport(source.url)`; the comment above it says the Function constructor exists to defeat bundler static analysis and that "Widget URLs must be from trusted sources only".
- Producers still alive: `packages/cli/src/utils/app-generator.ts` (two `type: 'module'` manifests), `packages/cli/src/commands/init.ts` (one), `packages/create-plugin/src/templates.ts` (one); the type is `RuntimeWidgetSource` in `packages/types/src/widget.ts`, whose JSDoc example is `source: { type: 'module', url: '/widgets/custom-chart.js' }`.
- Consumers of the registry in product code: the barrel `packages/core/src/index.ts` re-exports it; `plugin-charts` comments name it as "the tree's one consumer" of manifest defaults. No console code path constructs a `module` source (grep over `apps/console/src` and `packages/app-shell/src` for `type: 'module'` finds none; positive control: `ComponentRegistry` in 185 files).
- Issue dump: `new Function|WidgetRegistry` over 2,012 cards matches nothing.

## Recommendation

- [ ] Delete the `module` arm of `RuntimeWidgetSource` and `WidgetRegistry.load()`, and the four scaffold/template sites that emit it; keep `inline` and `registry`. Add the refusal text to the `default:` arm so an old manifest fails loudly.
- [ ] Changeset (`!`) for core, types, cli, create-plugin.
- [ ] If remote widgets are a wanted product capability (maintainer call), the contract-first shape is a signed manifest and an allow-listed origin, decided in spec — not a Function-constructor escape hatch in the renderer.

Effort S. External consumers of `type: 'module'` are 未实测.

Filed by the read-only whole-repo review session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01BDtwYUWhLGyWLzYQjZ95Cf` on 2026-10-24; the maintainer approved filing (「同意，创建任务」). Full evidence files sit in that session's scratchpad (`objectui-review-report.md`, `findings-*.md`). ⛔ Not a claim; for triage to grade and route.
